description: Subcomponent for `v-audio` that draws an amplitude waveform on top of `v-media-progress-bar`. Bind it in the `progress` slot of `v-audio`, or use it on its own with **peaks** and a model.

props.peaks: Precomputed amplitude values, normalized 0 to 1. Takes precedence over **peaks-source**.
props.peaksSource: Audio file decoded in the browser to draw the waveform, such as a `File` from `v-file-input` or a `Blob` fetched by the app. Decoding starts once the duration is known. MP3 and AAC decode at any length; other formats only up to 30 minutes.
props.bars: Fixed number of bars, stretched to the full width. When unset, as many bars as fit the width at **bar-width** and **bar-gap** are drawn. **peaks** shorter than the bar count are drawn as they are.
props.barWidth: Width of a single bar in pixels. With a fixed **bars** count it only sets the ratio to **bar-gap**.
props.barGap: Gap between bars, in the same units as **bar-width**.
props.barRadius: Corner radius of a single bar, capped at half its width. Ignored for bars narrower than 4px.
props.normalize: Rescales the peaks so the loudest bar reaches full height. Applied at render, so toggling it does not require decoding again.
props.sampleStrategy: How samples are reduced to one value per bar. `peak` preserves transients and suits speech; `rms` is smoother and suits music.
props.mirror: Reflects the bars below a baseline at a reduced opacity. A number from 0 to 1 sets the reflection height relative to the bars; `true` is 1.
props.live: Draws bars from the audio of the parent `v-audio` as it plays, scrolling right to left. Not seekable. Cross-origin media needs `crossorigin` on `v-audio`.
props.bgColor: Color of the unplayed bars. Falls back to the current text color at a reduced opacity.

events.update:modelValue: Emitted with the new position in seconds while clicking, dragging or using the keyboard.
events.drag:start: Emitted with the current position when the user starts dragging.
events.drag:end: Emitted with the final position when the user stops dragging.

slots.tooltip: Replaces the contents of the hover tooltip. Receives the formatted time, the chapter title and the hovered position in seconds.
